all_critic_dispositions.independent_judgment: The same-strong-ETag signal is supported when resource/representation and tag strength are established; it is distinct from local rehashing and extraction. Calling its absence material incomplete overstates the necessity for this generic proposal, but the final adds a valid optional distinction.

Permanent/temporary/303 distinctions are correct and useful. Final retains history without automatic identity merging or blanket forced review. GET-only checking avoids the consequential method-change edge; verified erratum 7109 was considered.

The corrected report and maintainer illustration support a conditional test risk, not an FTS5 ban or proof of a required append-only architecture. The final narrows topology/data/version claims and truthfully leaves fix status unknown.
Digest input boundary is usefully defined as persisted bytes, with encoded versus decoded policy stated as a design choice. This is specification precision, not a repudiation of local digests.
No actual target repo/schema/callers were supplied; final does not fabricate them or claim its upstream tests are handbook validation.
